name: html-phone-only-fixed-aside-main-stays-group
description: A page wrapper whose <aside> is a phone-only sticky bar (display:none from the tablet breakpoint up, position:fixed to the viewport bottom) next to <main> and two breakpoint spacers stays one core/group instead of becoming a row of equal core/columns.

source_reference.notes: Distilled from restaurant-platform page shells: .site-content > spacer-desktop + spacer-mobile + main + aside.mobi-footer--sticky. The sidebar/content name test must read each child's layout at the desktop reference viewport; an aside that is hidden and out of flow there is not a column partner.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
